goal: Build a fail-closed offline migration inventory, exact backup and restartable manifest for disposable profiles.
scope: Strict structured preflight with path-specific refusals
Profile-bound inventory of notes, workspace, attachments and edit receipts
Exact-byte backup, source-change detection and interrupted preparation recovery
No server writes, authority switch, legacy deletion or real-library migration
acceptance: All known lossy converter cases refuse without partial output
Backup readback matches exact source bytes and metadata remains untouched
Repeat and interrupted preparation retain stable profile-qualified target IDs
Changed source, corrupt backup, invalid ownership and unsafe paths refuse
Relevant tests, root verification and required visual evidence pass
nextAction: Implement and test the offline preparation adapter; resolve target creation separately before any server write.
